name: remix-v3-upgrade
description: Upgrade a Remix v3 project across beta and rc boundaries, currently up to 3.0.0-rc.3: the @remix-run/* version table for each hop plus every breaking change, including the ones the compiler will not catch — such as ui@0.8.0 renaming every rmx-* DOM attribute to data-rmx-*, and rc.3 changing the session cookie's wire format so every signed-in user is logged out on deploy. beta.7/8 were never published and beta.9 cannot install.
